title: On Christian Doctrine
translator: Shaw, J. F. (Rev. Professor J. F. Shaw, of Londonderry)
series: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Series I, Volume II
printBasis: New York: The Christian Literature Publishing Co., 1890 (CCEL header). Same Shaw text as the 1887 Buffalo Christian Literature Co. NPNF Series I Vol. II printing.
shawFirstPublished: Edinburgh: T. and T. Clark, 1873 (in The Works of Aurelius Augustine)
rights: Public domain in the USA. The CCEL NPNF1-02 plain-text header states Rights: Public Domain. The Shaw translation (1873) and the NPNF Series I Vol. II printings (1887, 1890) were published before 1931.
ccelTermsNote: CCEL says most editions are based on U.S. public-domain books; introductions, cover art, and other special contents may be copyrighted. The NPNF1-02 cache file used here declares Rights: Public Domain. CCEL asks contact for permission to republish CCEL works commercially; this hosted file is the public-domain Shaw/NPNF treatise text only (Preface and Books I to IV), not CCEL cover art or site special contents.
whyNotGutenberg: Project Gutenberg has no plain-text ebook of On Christian Doctrine (De Doctrina Christiana). Gutenberg does host Augustine Confessions and City of God separately.
whyNotNewAdvent: New Advent is link-only on this site. Its HTML was not copied.

extraction.method: Extracted lines for the Preface through the end of Book IV from the CCEL NPNF1-02 plain-text cache; unwrapped line breaks into paragraphs; normalized BOOK and CHAPTER headings for the reading-room contents list; dropped NPNF Argument abstracts under each Book; kept inline footnote markers and footnote definitions from the NPNF apparatus.
